comment: The component descriptions are intended for planning and procurement, but they do not include indicative implementation dependencies or sequencing. Countries may procure a component without the governance or data foundations needed to operate it effectively.

public.text: The component descriptions are intended for planning and procurement, but they do not include indicative implementation dependencies or sequencing. Countries may procure a component without the governance or data foundations needed to operate it effectively.
public.suggestedRevision: Add prerequisites and dependencies to each description, including governance readiness, authoritative data sources, terminology and model dependencies, foundational DPI integration, workforce needs, and transition requirements.
